title: Cooperation.
bodyText: The ethics commission may request and shall receive from every department, division, board, bureau, commission, or other agency of the State cooperation and assistance in the performance of its duties.
bodyHtml: §84-36  Cooperation.  The ethics commission may request and shall receive from every department, division, board, bureau, commission, or other agency of the State cooperation and assistance in the performance of its duties. [L 1972, c 163, pt of §1]
